authority: Vendor-neutral CoreSpirit capability inventory. This is a conservative audit baseline, not a feature-completion claim.

rules.implemented_verified: Only after feature-specific runtime contracts and required execution modes/backends passed on the same revision.
rules.implemented_unverified: Implementation source exists, but current evidence does not prove complete runtime behavior.
rules.partially_implemented: A subset exists and a known semantic or functional gap is recorded.
rules.catalog_only: Metadata exists without a proven executable provider.
rules.host_limited: CoreSpirit delegates the capability to a host/provider/device not guaranteed by the language runtime.
rules.missing: No implementation found for the declared capability.
rules.not_applicable: Capability does not apply to this runtime/domain.
